calibrated_solely_on: Cohort Chem-Dev-8 (Stage 4.0 Live Hardware Pilot: 20 QPU jobs, 353 PUBs, 238,080 physical shots)

estimator_1_frozen_dev_derived.origin_status: Developed post-hoc on Chem-Dev-8; frozen prior to any Chem-Holdout-24 execution for out-of-sample prospective validation

model_assumptions_and_exact_clipping_rul.noise_model: Effective global depolarizing channel on Z sector + Pauli-weight (w/M) depolarizing damping on non-Z groups + product single-qubit readout confusion channel

estimator_2_original_preregistered.origin_status: Original pre-registered v2.0 estimator retained side-by-side on all 24 holdout configurations and paired tests

frozen_h2_p4_fleet_routing_rule.deterministic_dispatch_predicate: Route intact 3-way or (3+2) molecule packs to IBM Heron when (n_qubits == 4 or model_type startswith JW); route intact 3-way molecule packs to IQM emerald when (n_qubits >= 6 and model_type == DOCI)
frozen_h2_p4_fleet_routing_rule.rationale: Preserves 3-way DOCI packing (-38.1% PUBs vs GroupSplit on Dev-8: 63 -> 39 PUBs) and prospectively tests with live independent hardware billing what was only a reconstructed counterfactual in Stage 4.0; single-provider P3_Prom_IBM and P3_Prom_IQM also allow offline comparison against GroupSplit.

statistical_plan_holdout24.primary_unit_of_inference: N = 24 paired molecular configurations averaged across W = 3 separated execution windows
statistical_plan_holdout24.multiplicity_correction: Holm-Bonferroni step-down across primary policy comparisons
